connect_neighbors: Smoothly connect the selected curve segment to its surrounding keys.
ease_in_out: Reshape the selected keys between ease-in and ease-out timing.
gap_stitcher: Close value gaps between neighboring animation segments.
noise_wave: Drag left for procedural noise or right for an alternating wave.
pull_push: Pull keys toward the neighboring trend or push them away.
simplify_bake: Drag left to simplify keys or right to bake additional keys.
smooth_rough: Smooth the curve or exaggerate its local variation.
time_offsetter: Offset the animation shape in time while preserving key times.
time_offsetter_stagger: Stagger whole-object animation while keeping channels synchronized.
scale_average: Scale selected values around their average.
scale_default: Scale selected values around the channel default.
scale_frame: Scale values around picked reference frames or the current frame.
scale_neighbor_left: Scale values around the preceding key.
scale_neighbor_right: Scale values around the following key.
